audit.note: The per-library projection holds the relapsers' state fraction at that library's measured value with no between-patient spread, so the cohort is homogeneous in the way that matters. The MRD-positive patients who do not relapse are assigned a state fraction this repository has never measured; the projection is swept over it rather than presented as a point. The measurement layer -- each library's own fold and state fraction -- carries no assumption at all.

control.note: The pooled inputs, re-projected on this script's code path, must reproduce the gate review's published operating-point AUCs.
